rationale:
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Removing the 'name' field from v1 schema requires updating both the construction of v1 entities and the observation of decoded v1 entities. The C# generated bindings will no longer have a Name property on Simulation.V1.Entity after buf generate. Both identified candidates must be edited to maintain consistency with the new schema while preserving entity_id and all other behavior.
runtimes/python/main.py: Removed all v1-specific construction, reading, and observation of the 'name' field. The generated v1 binding no longer has 'name' (field 2 is reserved). The three-service order, four round-trip cases, entity_id, and negative validation assertions are preserved. v2 behavior is unchanged. Both candidates required edits because they directly accessed the removed field.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Removed Entity.name from v1 construction and observations. The v1 schema no longer includes the name field (field 2 is reserved). The processEntity function now only extracts entity_id from decoded entities for both versions. The test payload construction for v1 no longer includes name. The subscribe flow will decode v1 payloads (including legacy ones with field 2) but the generated bindings will ignore the reserved field, so entity_id is preserved while name is simply not present in the decoded object.
assumptions: runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Generated bindings are regenerated by host via buf generate before compilation
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Simulation.V1.Entity parser still accepts legacy payloads with field 2 (reserved) and ignores unknown fields per proto3 semantics
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: No other references to V1.Entity.Name exist in this file
runtimes/python/main.py: The host has regenerated Python bindings via buf generate so that v1.Entity no longer has a 'name' attribute.
runtimes/python/main.py: No other runtime files in this source file reference entity.name.
runtimes/python/main.py: Reserved field 2 is ignored by the decoder; legacy payloads containing field 2 will be decoded without error and entity_id will be preserved.
runtimes/python/main.py: The pub/sub loopback and HTTP relay logic remain unchanged.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Generated TypeScript bindings for v1 Entity after buf generate will have only entityId property, no name property
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Decoding a legacy v1 payload containing field 2 (name) will preserve entity_id and silently drop the unknown/reserved field per protobuf semantics
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: The subscribe flow's processEntity call for v1 topics will work with both old and new payloads
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: v2 Entity construction and observations remain unchanged as intended
